instruction: Locate the community discussions and access the conversation with the maximum reply count.

metadata.explanation: Paraphrased instruction requiring navigation to discussions and opening the most-replied thread. Uses existing is_expected_active_tab metric with the same target URL.
metadata.verification: Verified that the expected URL is accessible and corresponds to a FlightAware discussion thread.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction by checking if the active tab URL matches the expected discussion thread URL
Getter (active_tab_info) appropriately extracts the active tab's URL from accessibility tree and loads the page to get full tab information
Metric (is_expected_active_tab) correctly compares actual URL vs expected URL using compare_urls() for proper URL normalization
Data flow is correct: getter extracts tab info dict with 'url' field, metric extracts URL and compares it
Expected URL (https://discussions.flightaware.com/t/the-banter-thread/4412) is verified to be a FlightAware discussion thread per metadata
Evaluator checks the correct end state (being on the right discussion thread) which implicitly verifies both navigation steps
Edge cases handled: returns 0.0 for empty/None active_tab_info, compare_urls() handles URL variations
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor concern: The 'maximum reply count' assumption may become stale over time if a different discussion thread gains more replies.
